user.title: Your club
user.description: Type the name of your club (or its 8-digit Ten'Up code).

cookie.title: Ten'Up session
cookie.description:
Ten'Up does not allow logging in with a password from an integration, so it needs your session.

1. **[Open Ten'Up]({site_url})** and **make sure you are logged in there** (your name should show at the top). Without that, the next steps give nothing.
2. Click the Ten'Up bookmarklet (its line is in the README, to be created once): it puts the session in your clipboard.
3. Come back here and paste it below.

Without the bookmarklet: developer tools (F12), Application tab, Cookies, then the value of the SHARED_SESSION_DRUPAL row. A "Copy as cURL" from the Network tab also works, pasted as is.

Only the useful cookie is kept, everything else is ignored and never stored.

Club: {club} ({club_code})

reauth_confirm.title: Ten'Up session expired
reauth_confirm.description:
The Ten'Up session for {club} ({club_code}) is no longer accepted.

1. **[Open Ten'Up]({site_url})** and **log in again** if needed.
2. Click the Ten'Up bookmarklet: it puts the new session in your clipboard.
3. Paste it below.

reconfigure.title: Ten'Up session
reconfigure.description:
Hand over a new session for {club} ({club_code}).

1. **[Open Ten'Up]({site_url})** and **make sure you are logged in**.
2. Click the Ten'Up bookmarklet: it puts the session in your clipboard.
3. Paste it below.
